stage: generational_comparison generational comparison (directive Phase D, Option A)
option: A — the single clean pair, chosen before generating. NO TREND LANGUAGE: one pair is a comparison.

headroom_normalisation.reading: the ambiguous stratum's larger RAW gain is substantially a low-baseline effect: normalised by headroom-to-oracle the generation closes LESS of the ambiguous gap (54.1%) than the sufficient gap (64.0%). An earlier draft of this note asserted the reverse and contradicted its own numbers.

partition_survives.reading: a generation of progress does not erase the difficulty axis

what_is_not_claimed: no trend, no rate of progress, no extrapolation to the next release. Two models one generation apart on one sample is a comparison, and model_sweep established that parameter count does not order accuracy at all, so no scaling statement is available either.
partition_used: classifier_refreeze canonical, 140/70, verified this session to reproduce exactly at 2%/1deg with identical composition across all five metric classes

process_defect.what: the analysis ran before its record was written; the accompanying document is a post-hoc analysis record, not a pre-registration
process_defect.why_it_matters: the headroom-to-oracle control was added after the raw deltas suggested a conclusion I distrusted. It reversed the reading, but it was not pre-committed.
process_defect.mitigation: every quantity is arithmetic on stored per-structure vectors and recomputable; the reversal is checkable rather than trusted
